traceability.notes: The story docs/stories/024.0-DEV-IGNORE-INLINE-CODE-REFS.story.md clearly define new behavior for comment normalization: normalizeCommentLine must strip backtick-wrapped content (e.g., `@story`, `@req`, `@supports`) before annotation detection, replacing it with spaces to preserve word boundaries, and this filtering must be centralized so it applies across all rules. Current implementation of normalizeCommentLine only trims whitespace, optionally removes a leading '*', and slices from the first @story/@req/@supports occurrence. It does not inspect or modify backtick-wrapped segments at all. There are also no tests referencing Story 024.0 or exercising inline-code/backtick patterns, and no external documentation mentioning this behavior beyond the story itself. Therefore multiple acceptance criteria are unmet (Core Functionality, Common Patterns, Real Annotations Detected, Multi-Line Support, Documentation), so this story is not yet fully implemented.
